name: Records and top intent
role: The intent, problems, ideals, solutions, implementations and metrics records, their generated docs and the checker configuration

name: Status script
role: Rewrites the status block of README.md from the records, and its test

name: Registry and docs
role: The registry of hubs (areas, researched candidates, each consumer hub connections and hand-wired services), the example lane config and the guides

name: Scorer and assembly core
role: The scorer that reads the registry with a consumer binding: eight checks per area and a combined score

name: Ports
role: : neutral ports moved out of a consumer core (usage scope, model provider, context assembly)

name: Web search code
role: : the web-search arms and the web research code moved out of a consumer (backends, cache, limiter, page fetch and extraction, the research adapter)

name: Model vendor code
role: Model vendor arms, the router and the Claude program arm.

name: Recall and card code
role: The card store, context assemblers and card builders.

name: Retrieval code
role: Retrieval of the context a task needs from a corpus of files under a token budget: chunking and descriptors, lexical, latent and dense arms, fusion, reranking, priors, a learned reranker and abstention.

name: Critique code
role: Link detection and the evidence check that holds an answer to its sources.

name: Action code
role: The file-editing arm, the folder writer and operation writing over MCP.

name: Agent runner code
role: Agent runners that drive Claude Code or an ACP agent.

name: Orchestration code
role: The planning and answering loop moved from a consumer.

name: Evaluation code
role: The per-seat cases, scorers and arm wrappers that esoi runs to record results.

name: Terminal renderers
role: : pure renderers from run events to framework-free blocks for any terminal frontend (work trace, interim folding, asks, stopped reason); moved in from a consumer

name: Consciousness code
role: Representatives, Judgment Calls and Request Intake: the person's authority, the decision to ask and the requests taken in.

name: Intake adapters
role: The adapters that say where a system's requests come from.

name: Proactivity code
role: Which standing schedules are due, by calendar period, requested run or event.
